item.title: Take Action: Stats show increase in slaughter-bound horses - Return to Freedom
item.description: Newly available statistics continue to show an increase in the number of American horses being trucked to Mexican and Canadian slaughterhouses. For this to stop, Congress must take action. The total number of slaughter-bound horses exported for all of 2025 now stands at 24,764, according to government statistics.
